messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday adjacent to a weekend, creating a three‑day break.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes / Provinces where it’s observed |
|------|---------|---------------------------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Observed in Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan, and Yukon (third Monday in February) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Observed in all provinces/territories that recognize it (most except Quebec) |
| **May 20** | Victoria Day | Federal holiday; observed in all provinces/territories (Monday before May 25) |
| **Aug 7** | BC Day | First Monday in August – British Columbia |
| **Jul 31** | Heritage Day | Last Monday in July – Alberta |
| **Aug 14** | Saskatchewan Day | Second Monday in August – Saskatchewan |
| **Aug 21** | Manitoba Day | Third Monday in August – Manitoba |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | First Monday in September – all provinces/territories |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | First Monday in October – all provinces/territories |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Observed in all provinces/territories (Monday) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday – all provinces/territories |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day | Friday – Newfoundland & Labrador (creates a long weekend) |
| **Apr 23** | St. George’s Day | Friday – Prince Edward Island (creates a long weekend) |

### How to use this data

* If your holiday‑planning app needs a **complete list per province**, you can filter the table by the “Provinces where it’s observed” column.  
* For a **national view**, simply keep the rows that apply to all provinces/territories (e.g., Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need additional details such as the exact day of the week each holiday fell on.
